title: US Congress Passes Sweeping Bipartisan Russia Sanctions Bill
detail: The US Congress passed a sweeping bipartisan Russia sanctions bill targeting energy exports and financial institutions in response to the ongoing war in Ukraine.

media.caption: US Congress passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill targeting energy exports

title: Ukrainian Drone Kills Russian Military Commander Recently Decorated by Putin
detail: A Ukrainian drone killed a Russian military commander who had just been decorated by President Putin, reportedly after the commander made false claims of a battlefield victory.

title: Russia Strikes Zaporizhstal Steel Plant for Fourth Time in a Month
detail: Russian forces struck the Zaporizhstal Iron and Steel Works with two ballistic missiles on the morning of September 17, injuring one worker and significantly damaging engineering and railway infrastructure. It was the fourth ballistic missile attack on the plant in a little over a month, with Metinvest COO Oleksandr Myronenko saying 17 ballistic missiles have hit the facility since August. The plant had not resumed full production from prior strikes on August 11, August 27 and September 12.

title: Russian Overnight Missile and Drone Barrage on Kyiv Injures Nearly 20, Including Children
detail: Russia launched a coordinated missile and drone assault on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast overnight into September 17: explosions began around 00:30 local time, ballistic missiles struck around 02:13, and drone activity continued past 07:00. At least 19-20 people were injured across more than 10 locations in the capital, including a 10-year-old girl and a 12-year-old boy, with 33 sites damaged region-wide. Damage included an education facility in the Holosiivskyi district and homes, agricultural equipment and commercial infrastructure in the Fastivskyi and Brovary districts. Ukraine's Air Force said it destroyed or suppressed 131 Russian aerial targets over Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia and Odesa regions during the attack. In response, Zelenskyy said Ukrainian forces struck an oil refinery in Yaroslavl and a military airfield in Russia's Rostov region overnight.

media.caption: Rescuers work at the site of an apartment building damaged during a Russian air strike in Kyiv, Sept. 17, 2026

title: Russian Strike on Korosten Industrial Park Kills 2, Injures 2
detail: Russian forces struck an industrial park in the Korosten district of Zhytomyr Oblast on the evening of September 17, killing two people and injuring two others who were hospitalized in moderate condition. The State Emergency Service said the strike sparked fires in warehouse and production buildings; rescuers had to briefly withdraw because of the threat of follow-up strikes. Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 93 strike drones nationwide that night (46 turbojet-powered) alongside Banderol and Dan-T cruise missiles, of which 69 drones and three missiles were downed or jammed, with strikes recorded at 13 locations; nationwide the barrage killed at least 6 and injured 34 over the prior 24 hours.
